verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud's pricing page directly states unlimited concurrency, which speaks to scaling simultaneous calls without requesting capacity, and it mentions agent profiles for different compute needs. The evidence is a single marketing-level line with no detailed concurrency or limit documentation and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented per-account concurrency/rate-limit specifics, autoscaling or warm-capacity mechanics, any quota-increase policy, independent evidence of scaling to many simultaneous calls.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging

citations.quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.
